@aws-sdk/client-s3.purpose: Temporary S3-material peer used only through src/s3/aws-sdk-adapter.ts for B2 S3 endpoint reachability, lifecycle, multipart, and usage-report object reads.
@aws-sdk/client-s3.policy: Must be removed when a stable @backblaze-labs/b2-sdk release covers the approved S3 helper gap.

@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner.purpose: Temporary UploadPart presigning peer used only through src/s3/aws-sdk-adapter.ts for s3_presign_upload_part.
@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner.policy: Must be removed when a stable @backblaze-labs/b2-sdk release exposes first-party S3 multipart presign helpers.

@backblaze-labs/b2-sdk.purpose: Primary Backblaze B2 transport and public SDK boundary for native B2, raw, S3 helper, and simulator-backed tests.
@backblaze-labs/b2-sdk.policy: Must remain a stable npm release pinned exactly in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml.

@smithy/types.purpose: Public AWS/Smithy command type boundary for the temporary S3 peer adapter.
@smithy/types.policy: Must stay pinned to the version resolved through the reviewed AWS SDK dependency set and be removed with the S3 peer adapter if the type import is no longer needed.

@modelcontextprotocol/server.purpose: Stable MCP server v2 runtime for stdio and Streamable HTTP handling.
@modelcontextprotocol/server.policy: Use public v2 server exports only; do not add the monolithic v1 SDK.

opossum.purpose: Circuit breaker runtime for bounded provider calls.
opossum.policy: Exact-pinned because major/runtime support changes can affect the Node engine floor.

pino.purpose: Structured server logging with existing secret-redaction policy.
pino.policy: No wrapper logging package may be added without review.

zod.purpose: MCP tool input schemas supplied to the server runtime.
zod.policy: Schema package additions require review; do not duplicate validation stacks.

process-warning.purpose: Reviewed pnpm migration transitive runtime package reached through pino warning paths.
process-warning.policy: Pinned by pnpm-lock.yaml after the npm-to-pnpm lock conversion moved the reviewed runtime graph from process-warning 5.0.0 to 5.1.0.

temporaryAdapters.name: s3-material-aws-peer-adapter
temporaryAdapters.removalCondition: Remove this adapter plus the AWS and Smithy direct dependencies after a stable @backblaze-labs/b2-sdk release exposes first-party helpers for the retained S3-material operations.

real-require.reason: Pinned production transitive packages currently require both pino's helper and thread-stream's nested helper.
